queer_characters.notes: His coming to terms with being gay is a central narrative thread explored with deliberate honesty; the source notes the show avoids gay stereotypes and Season 3's 'Eggplant' episode was praised for portraying intimacy rarely afforded to queer characters.

queer_creators.name: Josh Thomas
queer_creators.notes: Created, wrote, and starred as a fictionalized version of himself; the source describes this as own-voices representation, indicating Thomas shares his character's gay identity.
